description: Returns a high-level view of a domain's organic footprint: estimated organic traffic, organic keyword count, and a 0-100 domain authority score. Use this first for domain research. `backlinks` and `referringDomains` are ALWAYS null on this tool — no data provider feeds them here, so a null is the absence of a source, not a domain with no links. Call get_backlinks_overview for those. CHARGES CREDITS ON THE PAID DATA PROVIDER (~100-300 typical) for the organic traffic/keyword figures. On the default free provider that endpoint has no equivalent, so `organicTraffic` and `organicKeywords` come back null, nothing is charged, and only the authority score is populated. Null there means not measured — never report it as zero traffic. Read `authoritySource` before quoting `authority`: 'openpagerank' is link-graph authority, 'tranco' is a POPULARITY rank used as a stand-in and must be labelled as such; a domain outside Tranco's top million honestly returns null. A result carrying data is cached 12 hours per domain; a result with neither organic keywords nor an authority score is deliberately not cached, so retrying it re-runs the lookup.

includeSubdomains.description: Include subdomains in the domain's metrics. Defaults to false.

languageCode.description: Language code (e.g. 'en', 'es', 'fr'). Omit it to use the project's default market language, which falls back to 'en'.

locationCode.description: DataForSEO location code. Omit it to use the project's default market, which falls back to 2840 (United States) for a project that has not set one. See dataforseo.com/help-center/locations. Some countries (e.g. Iceland, 2352) are served from Google Ads data: keyword volume/CPC/trends work, but keyword difficulty, search intent, and domain analytics are unavailable.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: get_domain_overview
